item.title: An Unusual Route: Why I Chose Full-Time MOOCs Over Traditional Paths in 2016
item.description:
Looking back a decade to 2016, I made a decision that looked to everyone around me like career suicide: fresh out of a Diploma in Business Studies, I walked away from the conventional university conveyor belt and refused to settle into a standard 9-to-5 desk job.

Instead, I locked myself in my bedroom, turned on my monitor, and went all-in on full-time, self-directed learning through Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs).

item.title: 300km in 24 Hours - My Malaysia Ultra Solo Ride Record in Casual Gear
item.description: An unsupported 298 km solo ultra-cycling loop across Malaysia in 23h 17m on a DIY gravel bike in casual gear—proving mental grit beats elite equipment.

item.title: Pitch Black Detours and 2,000m+ Climbs: How I Conquered Fraser’s Hill Solo
item.description: A 20-hour, 200km solo gravel ride through pitch-black forest detours, surprise livestock encounters, pro paceline drafts, and 2,208m of climbing to Fraser's Hill—the foundational crucible that paved the way for my 300km graduation challenge.
